report_sentences: Reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch showed no detectable effect.
The factors were mass 0.1–10 kg, radius 0.02–0.2 m, shape, air_density 0.3–2.4, and the extremes of temperature, reflectance, stripes, hardness and batch.
- **Null effects.** Reflectance 0 vs 1, temperature −20 vs 80 °C, stripes 0 vs 10, hardness 1 vs 10 and batch 1 vs 50 all gave flight times within about 1% of the baseline.
The properties with no detectable effect are reflectance, temperature, stripes, hardness and batch.
